items.source: Use this to append additional metadata entries when using composite metadata. An IllegalArgumentException is raised if this method is used when not using composite metadata. The metadata value be a concrete value or any producer of a single value that can be adapted to a Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: 使用此方法在复合元数据中追加额外的元数据条目。如果在不使用复合元数据的情况下调用此方法，将抛出 IllegalArgumentException。 元数据值必须是一个具体值，或者是任何能够生成单个值的对象，该对象可以通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 适配为 Publisher。

items.source: metadata - an Object to be encoded with a suitable Encoder, or a DataBuffer
items.translation: metadata - 一个待用合适的 Encoder 编码的对象，或一个 DataBuffer

items.source: mimeType - the mime type that describes the metadata
items.translation: mimeType - 描述元数据的 MIME 类型

items.source: Spec for providing additional composite metadata entries.
items.translation: 提供额外复合元数据条目的规范。

items.source:
